title: Ignore client-supplied userId on interaction frames
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[scene] Ignore client-supplied userId on interaction frames
Spec (61f2d14): draft-atwood-jmap-scene-wss-00.md L409-412: "The server sets `userId` on the relayed event to the authenticated user's userId ({{JMAP-SCENE}}); a `userId` supplied in the frame is ignored. The server SHOULD also verify ... 1. The user has an active avatar ... in the region identified by `accountId` and `regionId`."
Code: crate-jmap-scene-server/src/ephemeral.rs:262-263; crate-jmap-scene-types/src/event.rs:120; crate-jmap-scene-client/src/ws.rs:112-115
Now: validate_interaction returns false (the frame is discarded) whenever event.user_id != caller. SceneInteractionEvent.user_id is a required String, so a client frame that omits userId fails to deserialize.
Change: Make userId optional on inbound frames, or default it. Have the server overwrite it with caller_user_id rather than compare it. validate_interaction (or a new helper) should return the event to relay with userId set, and look up the region by (accountId, regionId).
